# Audio Delivery QC Instructions

- Use current YouTube upload documentation for delivery specs. Standard YouTube
  masters normally use 48 kHz audio.
- Do not claim a universal official YouTube LUFS target. Use a documented
  channel target and record the measurement standard/settings.
- Measure the full approved program and re-check the encoded upload candidate
  for true peaks, sync, mutes, pops, channel mapping, and artifacts.
- Distinguish LUFS/LKFS, LU, and dBTP. Use true-peak checks, not sample peaks
  alone.
- Verify intelligibility on representative devices when practical: headphones,
  laptop/mobile speakers, and TV-style playback.
- Do not approve audio until rights, disclosure, AI/synthetic audio review,
  privacy, and reused-content risks are addressed.
